edits.note: CHG-R1-03 / CHG-R1-01 / A-07: FR-23 bounded exceptions E1 (Idle probe) and E2 (FLT-LOW diagnostic read)
edits.old: the "charger unbiased" state (the eFuse latched with T16 open) |
edits.new: the "charger unbiased" state (the eFuse latched with T16 open). **r8 exceptions to the I2C gate (CHG-R1-03; CHG-R1-01, A-01).** Each is bounded, uses the FR-07 engine and its caps, never sets i2c_fresh, never counts toward the QUAL or I2C-dead NACK rules and never changes `regnExpected`. **(E1) FR-12(b3) Idle probe:** in State 1 only, once per boot, after FR-12(b1) has passed and V_chg (pin 38) < 3 V (FR-12(b2)), with P5, QUAL, FCCEIL, REGEN and FCC LOW: one address poll to 0x6B; a NACK is expected (charger unpowered) and ignored; on an ACK, and only then, the FR-48(a) sequence runs: one ADC_EN one-shot write to REG2E, the REG3B VBAT_ADC read once the conversion has completed (tADC_CONV, SLUSDV2C §6.5), then ADC_EN cleared (REG2E written with ADC_EN 0 and read back; A-07: cleared so that the battery-only ADC draws no pack current in Idle, whether or not the one-shot clears it by itself, TODO(verify: SLUSDV2C Table 7-55 ADC_RATE one-shot behaviour)); at most three transactions follow the poll. **(E2) FLT-LOW diagnostic read:** when FLT (pin 35) reads LOW and V_chg > 10.2 V, both continuously for > 250 ms (the tCL_PLIM maximum is 202 ms, tps2663.pdf (SLVSE94G) §6.6: margin 48 ms, H.23(n)), one REG1B read; a NACK is expected (an eFuse that current-limits for longer than tCL_PLIM has latched off and the charger is unpowered) and ends the episode; an ACK with VBUS_PRESENT_STAT = 1 latches the carrier fault (a FLT reading that contradicts a powered charger: a FLT tap, R106s or bridge fault); an ACK with VBUS_PRESENT_STAT = 0 means the charger is battery-powered and runs the FR-48(a) check. One read per episode; the episode re-arms only after FLT reads HIGH or V_chg < 10.2 V. The pin-35 LOW level through R106s is 0.153 V typical and 0.325 V maximum against VIL 0.940 V (V_OL = I x R(FLT), R(FLT) 36-130 ohm, tps2663.pdf §6.5; H.23(n)) |

edits.new: **r8 (CHG-R1-D01): two operation-specific predicates.** (1) `flashWriteAllowed` (EEPROM commit, 'Z' clear) = mainState 1 (or State 98 with no profile, no 'J' session, no window) AND \|v_actual\| below 0.05 m/s for >= 1 s AND REGEN and FC_CHARGE EN LOW and read back LOW AND no charger window AND **bus support: either FC_BUS LOW (the r5 condition, a manually configured State 98) or battery-supported Idle, that is BT_BUS HIGH with its EN read back HIGH, BT_REG_ENABLE HIGH, V_bus >= `V_BUS_CHARGED_THRESH`, `busHotPlugUnsafe()` false, the share selector disarmed and no `shareIso*` / `shareSpCut*` flag or deferred BT cut standing** AND no bench SD log recording (sampling stopped) and no SD operation in flight AND NOT `chgHbRunning` AND `rtwdogMode == WDT_LONG`. Battery-supported admission covers the normal Idle vector 1 1 1 1 1 0 0 1 (F.2), in which FC_BUS stays HIGH: with the pack on the bus through BT_BUS, a purge during the IRQ-masked span (<= ~1.2 s, H.21(e)) removes only the FC contribution. `fcPurgeExposure()` is deliberately not used: it is TRUE in Idle whenever FC_REG is HIGH and the scheduler is unlocked (F.4), so it would refuse every Idle commit. (2) `sdOpAllowed` (SD close and sync only) = [mainState 1 AND NOT `chgHbRunning`] OR [State 98 with no 'J' session AND NOT `chgHbRunning`] OR [State 99 with `state99Phase == 3`, the latched phase: every path switch LOW, P5/QUAL/FCCEIL LOW, heartbeat stopped]; it does not test "no SD log open" (it exists to close that log) and is never TRUE in State 2, 3 or State 99 phases 0-2. (**superseded in r8:** one predicate `flashWriteAllowed` = mainState 1 (or State 98 with no profile, no 'J' session, no window) AND \|v_actual\| below 0.05 m/s for >= 1 s AND REGEN, FC_CHARGE and FC_BUS LOW AND no charger window AND no SD log open AND NOT `chgHbRunning` AND `rtwdogMode == WDT_LONG`; never TRUE in normal Idle, which keeps FC_BUS HIGH, and its "no SD log open" term blocked the SD close it also governed.) `flashWriteAllowed` is never TRUE in State 2, 3 or 99

**r8 (CHG-R1-D01): flash and SD gates separated.** The r5 predicate required FC_BUS LOW, which the normal Idle vector (F.2: 1 1 1 1 1 0 0 1) never has, so no commit was admitted outside a manually configured State 98; its "no SD log open" term blocked the SD close it also governed; and it allowed that close in State 99 phase 3 while it forbade State 99 in the same bracket. FR-43 now defines `flashWriteAllowed` (battery-supported Idle admitted, flash never in State 99) and `sdOpAllowed` (SD close and sync only: Idle and State 98 with the heartbeat stopped, and State 99 phase 3), each with its own bracket. The watchdog windowing is unchanged: both gates require the heartbeat stopped, so neither operation runs under the 50 ms RTWDOG timeout.
